prose: Fortune profiles Palo Alto Networks CEO Nikesh Arora, credited with growing revenue from $2.27 billion in fiscal 2018 to $11.48 billion in fiscal 2026 as AI reshapes cybersecurity. It describes him as the person Fortune 500 and tech CEOs call when AI gets scary. Based on the Techmeme excerpt; this is a retitled duplicate of an earlier Techmeme entry.
highlights: Go-to for CEOs worried about AI
